name: Krazek's Cookery
summary: In Booty Bay, Corporal Kaleb has a broken pot to get mended. He asks you to carry the mechanical cooker he bought from a goblin trader to Krazek.

sections.title: A Broken Pot
sections.body: Corporal Kaleb handles most of the camp's cooking. Before he bought a mechanical pot from a goblin trader in Booty Bay, cooking took hours. The pot spared him that work until it broke. Now he asks you to carry Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek, the goblin who can repair it.

sections.title: Krazek Takes a Look
sections.body: Krazek calls the pot ingenious work, though a spring can pop or a gear can slip. On inspection, he finds the steam charger rusted out, the knuckle-gasket cracked and the fobulator missing teeth. Krazek can mend it, but the repairs come at a price.

faq.answer: Corporal Kaleb sends you to Krazek. Kaleb handles most of the camp's cooking, and the mechanical pot he bought has broken down.
Krazek is a goblin trader in Booty Bay, where he sold the pot to Kaleb.

faq.q: What does Corporal Kaleb want carried to Krazek?
faq.answer: Kaleb asks you to carry Krazek's Crock Pot, a mechanical cooking pot that broke after saving him many hours of work.

faq.q: Why did Kaleb buy a cooking pot from Krazek?
faq.answer: Kaleb handles most of the camp's cooking, and the pot spared him many hours of work until it broke.
